project: JARVIS Trader — Audit Closeout Top-10 ROI (2026-06-11)
description: Execute the 10 highest-ROI tasks identified at the end of the 2026-06-11 full-system audit. Fix work happens on fix/audit-followups off master; merges to master per story group. Push to origin remains Amo-gated throughout.

userStories.title: Reconcile master with origin (ahead 9 / behind 7)
userStories.description: As Amo, I want master merged with origin/master so the audit work can be pushed without losing the peer's 7 commits.
acceptanceCriteria: Inspect the 7 behind commits before merging; conflicts resolved by HUNK, never whole-file ours/theirs
Runtime files (gate_v2_verdicts, strategy_c/output) backed up before merge and intact after
git status clean post-merge; git diff --stat sanity sweep done
Engine still healthy after merge (no code path broken): /health full gate
Push itself NOT executed (Amo-gated) — surface ready-to-push state

userStories.title: Dashboard null-guard pass on crashing pages
userStories.description: As a dashboard user, I want /command-center, /backtest, /performance to render instead of crashing into error boundaries when API data is missing.
acceptanceCriteria: Root-cause each crash (.toFixed, .slice, .length on undefined) in the page sources
Guards use != null pattern (amo-arbitrage lesson), nullable TS types where touched
pnpm build passes; Playwright shows all three pages render with zero unhandled error-boundary catches

userStories.title: Fix Command Center signal fetch (8020 -> 8010)
userStories.description: As a Command Center user, I want the signal tab live; it currently fetches /api/signal on the 8020 bridge where the route does not exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Determine correct source for /api/signal (8010 engine or add route to 8020 bridge) by reading both APIs
Fix the fetch in dashboard/public/strategy-c-command-center.html (and source if generated)
Playwright: /strategy-c-command iframe shows zero 404s

userStories.title: Add/repair the missing engine routes the dashboard calls
userStories.description: As a dashboard user, I want the 404/500 engine endpoints fixed: /portfolio/history/equity-curve, /analytics/regime, /paper/trade-journal, /ib/connection-test, /signals/recent, /analytics/daily-pnl (404s) and /portfolio/paper/hold-time-stats (500).
acceptanceCriteria: For each: decide implement vs repoint-dashboard-to-existing-route (read engine routers first; some may exist under different paths)
Each fixed endpoint returns 200 with sane JSON against the live engine
Regression tests added for new/changed routes; pytest green on touched modules
Playwright: dashboard home + /paper + /performance show zero 404/500 engine calls

userStories.title: Loosen /safety/status rate limit for dashboard polling
userStories.description: As a dashboard user, I want /safety/status to stop 429ing under normal page loads.
acceptanceCriteria: Find the limiter config on safety router; raise limit or exempt the dashboard proxy appropriately
Playwright multi-page sweep shows zero 429s
Test covering the new limit behavior if testable

userStories.title: Verify approval-alert loop end-to-end
userStories.description: As Amo, I want proof the repaired Telegram + Discord channels fire on a real approval candidate so candidates never expire unseen again.
acceptanceCriteria: Trigger or await one approval-candidate notify (test path acceptable if it cannot be mistaken for a real signal)
Engine logs show Telegram 200 + Discord 2xx for the notify
Finding documented with log artifact paths

userStories.title: Schedule weekly paper tearsheet
userStories.description: As Amo, I want jarvis_tearsheet.py --source paper running weekly under pm2 cron so QS snapshots accumulate without manual runs.
acceptanceCriteria: pm2 cron entry added to ecosystem.config.js (pattern: jarvis-rolling-wfe), engine venv python, DB_PATH correct
One manual run via the exact pm2 command path succeeds and writes tearsheet + METRICS_SNAPSHOT.json
pm2 save executed (pm2 changes were authorized in this audit scope)

userStories.title: Restart 30-day paper validation on MES/MGC
userStories.description: As Amo, I want the formal 30-day validation window restarted on the active symbols with the new 10-gate QS layer, replacing the abandoned MCL window.
acceptanceCriteria: Read the paper-validation subsystem; document exactly what restarting entails and any state it resets
If restart is non-destructive: execute and verify /paper/validation/progress shows a fresh MES/MGC window
If it resets/destroys trading state: STOP and surface as Amo decision with the exact command — do not execute

userStories.title: Primary LLM restoration — prep the Vertex lever
userStories.description: As Amo, I want everything short of the gated flip done so restoring the primary LLM is one action: verify Vertex failover code path readiness and document the exact steps.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm JARVIS_LLM_VERTEX_FAILOVER code path present and tests green
Document exact flip procedure (env edit + restart) and the GCP prerequisite state
Flag clearly: flip itself NOT executed (Amo-gated)

userStories.title: Twilio dead-channel remediation (non-gated half)
userStories.description: As Amo, I want the Twilio channel to stop silently failing 66x: gate it behind a config check so a dead credential logs ONE clear warning instead of repeated 401 noise, with rotation remaining my action.
acceptanceCriteria: Notifier degrades gracefully: on auth failure, disable channel for the process lifetime + single loud warning log
No behavior change when creds are valid (test both paths)
Rotation steps documented for Amo (1Password Twilio item)
